data.label: Ak'Anon
data.lore: Ak'Anon is an ancient city, built into the edge of the mountains long ago by the gnomes who call it home. Half fortress and half laboratory, the gnomes have been developing their clockwork machines and defenses here for generations, and show no signs of stopping.

data.label: East Cabilis
data.lore: Cabilis (sometimes called New Sebilis) is the new heart of the Iksar Empire. The Iksar recaptured the city from the Sarnak long ago and have since made it their new home.

data.label: Erudin
data.lore: Erudin is the home city of the Erudites, a sect of humans that long ago migrated from the known world to settle in an out of the way place and study the known and unknown.

data.label: Greater Faydark
data.lore: Greater Faydark is one of the largest and most confusing regions in all of the world of Norrath. It is quite vast, with the added bonus of being dark at all times with very few recognizable landmarks to tell where you are at any given time.

data.label: Grobb
data.lore: Grobb is very small compared to some of the human towns on Antonica, and very utilitarian in its design. The entrance from the vicious Innothule Swamp is heavily guarded by trolls, and the interior of the caverns has many sights that would turn an outsider's stomach.

data.label: Halas
data.lore: Halas is a city like its inhabitants, simple and to the point. Only barbarians would even consider swimming in the lake that provides them protection instead of waiting for the raft to carry them across, swimming without fear in the frigid waters.

data.label: Neriak
data.lore: Neriak is the center of the Dark Elven empire, and is a splendid, dark city that lies carved out of the mountians next to the Nektulos Forest. No natural light has ever seen their homeland, and the dark elves thrive and flourish in their city.

data.label: Oggok
data.lore: Oggok is simple from the outside, and if you were to fly over the cove you would only see a few small huts and one large building jutting from the face of the side of it.

data.label: Rivervale
data.lore: Rivervale is a quiet town, hidden well in the valley surrounding a small lake that is the head of a river running through Antonica. The layout of the town is simple, with tunnels burrowed through rock as its entrances and the river running out through a narrow, unpassable gorge.

data.label: South Qeynos
data.lore: Qeynos is one of the largest cities in all of Norrath, and one of the two large coastal cities run by the humans. The docks of the city provide trade from Qeynos to the high human city of Erudin, as well as to other areas along the coast.

data.label: Southern Felwithe
data.lore: Felwithe is the legendary city of the high elves, which rises out of the fog of Greater Faydark as one of the most wonderful cities in all of Norrath. Its golden walls give off a faint glow all their own, and the peaceful city attracts many visitors from abroad.

data.label: Surefall Glade
data.lore: Surefall Glade is the haven for the Rangers and Druids of the western coast of Antonica.

data.label: West Freeport
data.lore: Freeport is considered by most to be the hub of Antonica for a variety of reasons. It is the mercantile center of the continent, since it holds the only port with a regular boat to the island continent of Faydwer.

This spell has the potential to tick a 5th time, totaling 1500 hit-points, depending on when it lands on your target (similar to how dot ticks work). The overall mana efficiency is 7.5 or 6 hp/m.

Consumes an Emerald when cast (Emerald costs around 13p).

This spell stacks with all other buffs except Primal Essence and Aura of Battle.

''Patch change 20 Feb, 2012: Kanras: Updated Avatar to give 100 AGI.''

data.label: Malo
data.description:
Decreases your target's resistance to cold, fire, magic, and poison.

Note: Casting this spell is irresistible which will land 100% of the time. This explains it's extremely high price tag and the necessity against high target monsters and end game bosses.

data.label: Focus of Spirit
data.description:
Focuses your target's spiritual energy, granting increased hit points, strength, and dexterity for 1 hour(s) 40.0 mins.
This spell has an unusual stacking mechanic. If a character has Focus, it will block the addition of Maniacal Strength, Mortal Deftness, and Voice of the Berserker spells. ''However'' if the character already has those buffs prior, the addition of Focus on top of those will not overwrite them, rather it will stack and both will apply to the character's statistics. Therefore, if a melee character would like all three buffs, they should click off any pre-existing Focus, then ask the Shaman for them.
Focus of Spirit will always overwrite other Talisman spells however. It also seems to overwrite lower level spells such as Dexterity.

Does not stack with Shield of the Magi and other INT caster HP buffs. Does not stack with Bedlam and other enchanter mat-free runes in that line. Does stack with Resurrection Effects.

data.label: Qeynos Hills
data.lore: Qeynos Hills is an area one step above the newbie area of North Qeynos and a very popular hunting ground between Qeynos and Surefall Glade. Qeynos Hills provides good hunting for the levels above although it can be heavily trafficked at times with monks looking to get their putrid bones, and others looking for pelts.

data.label: Blackburrow
data.lore: Blackburrow is the home of the Blackburrow clan of gnolls. It is something of a combination between underground dungeon and above ground hunting area, and represents the only pathway to get from Everfrost and the home of the barbarians to the Qeynos Hills and lands beyond.

data.label: Eastern Karana
data.lore: The Eastern Plains of Karana is a rough, rocky area that is populated with some very dangerous creatures indeed. It's connected to the rest of Norrath by a long narrow mountain pass on one end, and an impressively large wooden bridge at the other.

data.label: Gorge of King Xorbb
data.lore: The Gorge of King Xorbb, also known as the Beholder's Maze, is a narrow collection of gulleys and ravines that are very similar to those in Highpass Hold. Unlike its southern neighbor, this area has much less friendly occupants.

data.label: Highpass Hold
data.lore: Highpass Hold (sometimes incorrectly referred to as Highhold Pass) is a mountain pass on a route from Qeynos to Freeport, guarded by the valiant guards of High Keep.

data.label: Kithicor Forest
data.lore: Kithicor Forest has recently become a much more dangerous, dark place. In days past, it was a quiet woods where an intrepid explorer could find many things of interest, but now it is overrun.

data.label: Misty Thicket
data.lore: Misty Thicket is the major newbie zone for Rivervale (with a smaller one existing in Kithicor). It is also an area that the halflings have staked out to protect their city from the dangers of the Runnyeye goblins to their west.

data.label: Nektulos Forest
data.lore: Nektulos Forest is a dark forest that lies north of the Commonlands on the eastern half of Antonica. It is home to a clan of halflings, and is also patrolled by the dark elves from nearby Neriak.

data.label: Northern Desert of Ro
data.lore: The Northern Desert of Ro is a highly trafficked and popular area that marks the southern edge of the human city of Freeport as well as the northern edge of the vast Desert of Ro.

data.label: Southern Desert of Ro
data.lore: Southern Desert of Ro marks the southern edge of the vast and dangerous Desert of Ro. It is the home base for the orcs that have spread northward into the desert proper, and their huts literally cover the grassy region next to the moister Innothule Swamp to the south.

data.label: Upper Guk
data.lore: Upper Guk is a great dungeon from levels 15-35 or so. The loot isn't the greatest, although Ghoulbane and the ancient croc are two highly prized spawns in the zone.

data.label: The Feerrott
data.lore: The Feerrott is the dark swampy home of the ogres and lizard men of Antonica. The ogres live in a cave system at the edge of the swamp, while the lizard men have established camps scattered throughout.

data.label: Neriak Foreign Quarter
data.lore: Neriak is the center of the Dark Elven empire, and is a splendid, dark city that lies carved out of the mountians next to the Nektulos Forest. No natural light has ever seen their homeland, and the dark elves thrive and flourish in their city.

data.label: Neriak Commons
data.lore: Neriak is the center of the Dark Elven empire, and is a splendid, dark city that lies carved out of the mountians next to the Nektulos Forest. No natural light has ever seen their homeland, and the dark elves thrive and flourish in their city.

data.label: Neriak 3rd Gate
data.lore: Neriak is the center of the Dark Elven empire, and is a splendid, dark city that lies carved out of the mountians next to the Nektulos Forest. No natural light has ever seen their homeland, and the dark elves thrive and flourish in their city.

data.label: Southern Karana
data.lore: South Karana is a very quiet place. It’s inhabitants consist of Aviaks, Splitpaw Gnolls, the mystical Quillmane, and normal critters. The Aviaks are very peaceful to most races but it is to be noted that they don’t like trolls or ogres!

data.label: Lake Rathetear
data.lore: Lake Rathetear (abbreviated as Lake Rathe) is a large lake, almost a small sea, that sits nestled in the distant wilds of Antonica.

data.label: Rathe Mountains
data.lore: The Mountains of Rathe is a vast and dangerous mid level zone. It lies along the southern route from Freeport to Qeynos. The high peaks hide away many separate areas within the zone, each with its own dangers and things to discover.

data.label: Crushbone
data.lore: Crushbone is the home of the Crushbone clan of orcs. It is located directly to the north of the wood elf city of Kelethin, and is the major thorn in the sides of all the inhabitants of Faydwer.

data.label: Lesser Faydark
data.lore: Lesser Faydark is a dark forest which, unlike its neighbor Greater Faydark, has been overrun by the evil orcs and bandits, as well as the much more powerful undead sprites and other corrupted creatures.

data.label: Dagnor's Cauldron
data.lore: Dagnor's Cauldron is a barren wasteland that separates Butcherblock Mountains from the haunted Estate to the south. One can't imagine what manner of impact, whether magical or natural, rent this landscape to make it as twisted and ugly as it is now.

data.label: Toxxulia Forest
data.lore: Toxxulia Forest is a dark and quiet forest that encompasses much of the island continent of Odus. It is separated into two areas by a river running roughly east to west through it, the northern half more habited and the southern half controlled by the kobolds and the necromancers.

data.label: Field of Bone
data.lore: The Field of Bone gets its name from the former reservoir of Cabilis which is now home to bones and wandering undead, remnants of a battle in years past. The area, while bone dry itself, is surrounded by plant life and wetlands.

data.label: Lake of Ill Omen
data.lore: The Lake of Ill Omen (aka "LOIO") is the ancient site of the city of Varnek, which was cursed ages ago and has since sank beneath the waters, giving the local area its name.

data.label: Emerald Jungle
data.lore: The Emerald Jungle is a vast, beautiful, and dangerous jungle. It is separated from the rest of the continent by a large cliff where it is sunken into the earth.

data.label: Skyfire Mountains
data.lore: The Skyfire Mountains are named for the reddish glow that lights the skies at night, created by the lava that flows across this broken land. The dragons have claimed this part of Kunark their domain, and their kind move freely over the dangerous terrain protecting their stronghold, Veeshan's Peak.

data.label: Frontier Mountains
data.lore: The Frontier Mountains are the highest and roughest set of mountians located on the continent. These harsh mountains cut across the western half of the continent, and are inhabited by a variety of powerful, large creatures, for whom the peaks are mere hills.

data.label: Great Divide
data.lore: The Great Divide is a heavily mountainous area, cutting the continent of Velious into two halves, east and west. The harsh environment is home to all nature of powerful creatures.

data.label: Eastern Wastes
data.lore: The Eastern Wastes are a vast area of frozen ground covering much of the northeastern continent of Velious. There are many groups here, the Coldain, the Frost Giants, and the orcs of Ry'Gorr Keep, who have outposts or homes here.

data.label: Kael Drakkal
data.lore: Kael Drakkel (Sometimes Kael Drakkal) is the home city of the giants of Velious - the Kromzek and the Kromrif. The city was founded by giant refugees fleeing the wrath of the other gods after Rallos Zek's invasion of the Plane of Earth.

data.label: Skyshrine
data.lore: A large tower located in the Wakening Lands. Skyshrine is the home of Lord Yelinak, the Dragon who controls the zone, keeping the Giants from getting to the Western Wastes.

data.label: Iceclad Ocean
data.lore: The Iceclad Ocean consists of two parts, the open ocean between it and the other continents of Norrath, and Icy Fingers, a series of small fragmented islands that lead to the continent of Velious itself.

data.label: Gravity Flux
data.description:
'''Two different incompatible versions of this spell exists in game.''' One is crafted by Wizards and the other is crafted by Enchanters. Causes a sudden reversal in the gravity around your target, doing 214 damage. Only hits 4 mobs max. Please confirm damage at various levels.

Quad-kiting Wizards are recommended to use the more mana efficient Circle of Force until level 51, then Pillar of Frost. This spell has an alternate use to project yourself/duel to locations not easily accessible like ramparts of CoM. When cast by NPCs, this spell can be very dangerous against players, as fall damage can be very brutal, especially if they are overweight or fall off nearby cliffs. Levitate and Dead Man Floating can counter this risk.

While under the effect of this spell, a new low level NPC is spawned that looks like a spinning eye. After a short delay, the camera switches to follow this eye and the caster can control it with most normal movement commands. The eye has the same faction as the player, and if the player is not under Feign Death, they will gain any aggro which the eye has. Thus, it is useful as a long-range pulling method.
Like other NPCs, players can attack the eye and cannot buff it ''(not sure if it's a case-by-case basis but I regularly cast Bedlam on my eyes without issue to get extra hits in)''. It's possible to summon the eye and hit it with weapons such as the Worker Sledgemallet just to gain a proc effect. It has good swimming speed but cannot jump and may have difficulty getting out of the water.

Can not be cast in Plane of Sky or Kedge Keep.

data.label: Tishan's Relocation
data.description:
Opens an arcane portal that teleports your entire group to the Skyfire Mountains. This spell no longer has a Kunark dungeon requirement; it can currently be cast from anywhere in the world.

'''Warning: The port in location for this spell is very dangerous.''' If you port in while visible, you will most likely die when alone or porting another. There are swarms of dispelling mobs at the zone in area. However, while invis, this port in location is nearly 100% safe. No mobs see invis and the only threat is the possibility of it breaking early. You can enter the zone invisibly by getting a friendly person to invis prime you. To perform this, join a group, and have that person begin to invis you. Before their cast finishes, begin your cast of Tishan's Relocation. Once their invis hits you, disband or have them disband before you finish the cast. You will port over to skyfire while remaining invis, as finishing casts does not break invisibility. With a primed invis, the port in at skyfire is much safer, and a very useful tool to Wizards.

Strikes your target with energy, stunning them briefly and causing 200 damage. Supersedes Tishan's Clash.

Mana efficiency is 1.0 DPM.

data.label: Rend
data.description:
Tears the flesh from your target, causing between 774 and 784 damage. 124.4 DPS, 2.8 DPM.

Does '''not''' have a knockback component.

data.label: Wrath of Al'Kabor
data.description:
Creates a freezing ice storm that causes 448 damage to several creatures in the vicinity of your target.
Single target mana efficiency of 0.9.
This spell in its scroll form reads '''Wrath of Ap'Sagor'''. It scribes as '''Wrath of Al'Kabor'''.

data.label: Ice Comet
data.description:
Summons a giant comet of ice from the sky. Mana efficiency of 2.8 and 176 DPS.
WARNING: Due to the high damage it causes it creates a high amount of agro. So be sure the puller or tank is prepared.

data.label: Ward of Calrena
data.description: Places the Ward of Calrena on your target, absorbing a portion of incoming spell damage. This spell absorbs a set amount of damage before dissipating. Consumes a jasper when cast.

data.label: Mana Detonation
data.description: Detonate the raw mana between you and your target, causing 800 damage and violently knocking the target, and yourself, back. This damage is incredibly difficult to resist.

data.label: Translocate
data.description:
Opens an arcane portal that teleports your target to their bind point. Does not require Small Portal Fragments as a reagent.

Note: The Translocate box lasts 5 minutes.

data.label: High Keep
data.lore: High Keep is the seat of a former empire that used to spread its power over central Antonica in years past. Now, their reign has diminished to Highpass Hold due to constant attacks by the orcs and gnolls.

data.label: Ocean of Tears
data.lore: The Ocean of Tears is a vast expanse of water that lies between the continents of Antonica and Faydwer. A boat makes frequent trips between the Butcherblock Mountains and Freeport, taking travelers of all types over the ocean.

data.label: Befallen
data.lore: Befallen was once the site of a wonderful temple, a reclusive home for the monks who maintained it. Many blame the dark elves for what it has become, but whatever the cause, Befallen is now a home to the undead its inhabitants used to hunt and destroy.

data.label: Temple of Cazic Thule
data.lore: The Lost Temple of Cazic-Thule (later revamped to the Accursed Temple) lies deep in the swamps in the south of Antonica, hidden on an island beneath vines and protected by its caretakers and worshippers, the lizard men.

data.label: Runnyeye Citadel
data.lore: RunnyEye Citadel (formerly Clan RunnyEye) is the underground home of the Pickclaw clan of goblins. Their tunnels wind their way through the hills, carving deeper and deeper down into the depths.

data.label: Lower Guk
data.lore: The Ruins of Ancient Guk is a vast array of tunnels that connect between the ruins themselves and the upper tunnelways that eventually lead to the Innothule Swamp.

data.label: Nagafen's Lair
data.lore: Nagafen's Lair (informally called Sol B) is a large set of caverns that lie deep in the Lavastorm Mountains. Buried deep inside these caves is the lair of the Fire Giants, who are the personal servants of the mighty dragon, Lord Nagafen.

data.label: Najena
data.lore: Najena is the ancient home of a twisted dark elf magician named Najena, who carved out this hole in the hidden areas of the Lavastorm Mountains in which to carry out her experiments, as well as those of her allies.

data.label: Permafrost
data.lore: Permafrost Keep is an ancient castle buried in the glacial flow that is slowly claiming the northlands of Norrath. Most of the castle lies in ruins, and what is left consists of excavated areas of the old castle and a warren of caves dug out by the goblins who serve their dragon master.

data.label: Solusek's Eye
data.lore: Solusek's Eye (informally called Sol A) is the cavernous home of both the fire goblins and their allied clans, and the Solusek Mining Company, an intrepid group of gnomes here for the mineral wealth this area has to offer.

data.label: Splitpaw
data.lore: Splitpaw Lair (formerly Infected Paw) used to be the home of the Splitpaw clan of gnolls. Now their tribal home has been overrun by another more powerful clan of gnolls, intent on their own political agenda, who use the Splitpaw clan any way that they can.

data.label: Temple of Solusek Ro
data.lore: The Temple of Solusek Ro ("Sol Ro") is a unique zone, new to the world of Norrath. It is a zone not for adventuring and hunting, killing monsters or selling goods, but for interacting with the inhabitants of the Temple.

data.label: The Hole
data.lore: The Hole -- officially known as The Ruins of Old Paineel -- was created at the end of the Erudin/Heretics war, when the Heretics used their magical powers to punch a hole in the earth deep into the depths of Odus.

data.label: The Warrens
data.lore: In the heart of the continent of Odus, The Warrens is a network of caves that the kobolds of Clan Kolbok have claimed as their own.

data.label: Kedge Keep
data.lore: Kedge Keep is the ancient fortress of the Kedge, an aquatic race of beings whose civilization perished centuries ago. A few of the kedge can be found within, but mostly the other inhabitants of the Keep stay inside.

data.label: Mistmoore Castle
data.lore: Castle Mistmoore is the stronghold of the ancient dark elf vampire, Mayong Mistmoore, and his throngs of followers. The castle itself has vast, mazelike corridors and secret areas, hidden away from prying eyes.

data.label: The Estate of Unrest
data.lore: The Estate of Unrest was once the home of a dwarven noble, in ages past. Following the unholy destruction that created Dagnor's Cauldron and the following takeover of that region by evil creatures, his estate was overrun by the undead, and is now one of the great havens of the unliving in all of Norrath.

data.label: Balanced
data.description: All incoming damage is reduced by 10% and your chance to hit is increased by 10%. Endurance regen excluding out of combat bonus regen is doubled. There is no endurance cost to upkeep this stance.

data.label: Berserker
data.description: While this stance is active, attack speed and combat skill recharge rate is doubled and your chance to hit and combat skill damage is increased by 25%. Every point of damage dealt consumes half that amount in endurance, with a reduction based on your strategy skill. You also take 8.3% of outgoing damage to yourself. Bonus damage from critical hits and similar effects do not cost endurance.

data.label: Channeler
data.description: All incoming damage is reduced by 40% and your chance to successfully channel is increased. Half of the mitigated damage is charged to both mana and endurance, with a reduction based on your strategy skill.

data.label: Defensive
data.description: All incoming melee damage is reduced by 50% and incoming magical damage is reduced by 20%. Every point of damage reduced consumes an equal amount of endurance, with a reduction based on your strategy skill.

data.label: Evasive
data.description: You have a 95% chance to evade all incoming attacks. Every point of damage evaded consumes 2 endurance, with a reduction based on your strategy skill. Evasion will fail if you have insufficient endurance, or while playing dead.

data.label: Mage Hunter
data.description: All incoming spell damage is reduced by 50% and incoming physical damage is reduced by 20%. Every point of damage reduced consumes an equal amount of endurance, with a reduction based on your strategy skill.

data.label: Offensive
data.description: Outgoing melee damage is increased by 100% and your chance to hit is increased by 25%. Every point of bonus damage dealt consumes an equal amount of endurance, with a reduction based on your strategy skill. When below 25% endurance, the chance to hit bonus is reduced based on the remaining percent of endurance. Bonus damage from critical hits and similar effects do not cost endurance.

data.label: Ranged
data.description: Your range attack has no minimum distance, gains a 25% accuracy bonus, and can double and triple attack. Every point of damage consumes endurance, with a reduction based on your strategy skill.

data.label: Striker
data.description: Outgoing weapon skill abilities deal 3x damage and non-weapon skill abilities deal 5x damage, and your chance to hit is increased by 25%. Every point of damage dealt consumes an equal amount of endurance, with a reduction based on your strategy skill. When below 25% endurance, the chance to hit bonus is reduced based on the remaining percent of endurance. Bonus damage from critical hits and similar effects do not cost endurance.

data.label: Arcane Mastery
data.description: Spell cast and recovery times are reduced by 25% plus 10% per additional intelligence class. The mana cost of detrimental spells is reduced by 15% plus 5% per additional intelligence class.

data.label: Divine
data.description: Spending mana will heal the group member with the lowest hp percentage by that amount. For every additional wisdom class, this will repeat with a heal for 33% of the mana spent.

data.label: Empower
data.description: Adds 40% plus 20% per additional non-hybrid casting class to Damage effects at the cost of 40% more mana. Adds 20% plus 10% per additional non-hybrid casting class to Healing effects at the cost of 20% more mana.

data.label: Inversion
data.description: Shifts two-thirds of spell cast time into the global recovery time and 20% of the mana cost into half as much in endurance cost.

data.label: Inviolable
data.description: Cast spells are uninterruptible at the cost of 100% more mana and the same amount as endurance.

data.label: Over Channel
data.description: Cast spells have a -150 resist adjust plus another -15 for every non-hybrid caster class at a cost of 10% of the mana cost in endurance.

data.label: Recovery
data.description: You regenerate mana twice as fast and spells have a 5% reduced mana cost. Out of combat regen bonus is not affected.

data.label: Spellblade
data.description: Treats the first spell-gem slot as a proc that consumes both mana and endurance on activation. 40% of the spells mana cost is paid as mana and 20% as endurance. The spell must have a reuse time less than or equal to its cast time.

data.label: Unyielding
data.description: Health regen excluding out of combat bonus regen is doubled, with a 25% resistance increase to loss of control from fear, mez, and charm. There is no mana cost to upkeep this stance.

data.label: Adamant Will
data.description: This passive ability grants you an additional 20/40/?/?% chance to resist charm, and 15/30/?/?% chance to resist mesmerization spells. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Alchemy Mastery
data.description: This passive ability reduces the chance of failing Alchemy recipes by 10/?/?%. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Baking Mastery
data.description: This passive ability reduces the chance of failing Baking recipes by 10/?/?%. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Blacksmithing Mastery
data.description: This passive ability reduces the chance of failing Blacksmithing recipes by 10/?/?%. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Brewing Mastery
data.description: This passive ability reduces the chance of failing Brewing recipes by 10/?/?%. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Circular Breathing
data.description: This passive ability increases your endurance regeneration by 1/2/3/4 point(s). Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Combat Agility
data.description: This passive ability increases your melee avoidance by 2%/5%/10%. Melee avoidance is the component of armor class that allows you to avoid incoming attacks and is derived from agility, item avoidance, and your defense skill. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Combat Fury
data.description: This passive ability increases your chance of performing a critical melee hit with all skills by 1/?/5/10%. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Combat Stability
data.description: This passive ability increases the armor class soft cap of your class by 2/5/?%. The armor class soft cap is the amount of armor class that functions at 100% effectiveness. Armor class gains in excess of this cap are reduced in effectiveness by a percentage based on your class and level.

data.label: Crafting Mastery
data.description: Training with the sages and merchants of Norrath gives adventurers the chance to hone their crafting skills. This passive ability allows you to raise 1/2/3/4/5/6 additional standard tradeskill (Baking, Blacksmithing, Brewing, Fletching, Jewelcraft, Pottery, or Tailoring) from its initial Specialization cap of 200 up to 300. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Fear Resistance
data.description: This passive ability grants you an additional 25/50/75/100% chance to resist most fear spells and increases the chance of breaking fear earlier. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: First Aid
data.description: This passive ability increases the maximum health you can bind wound to 80/90/100/100/100/100% and increases the amount of healing provided by a single bandage by 0/0/0/10/25/50%. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Fletching Mastery
data.description: This passive ability reduces the chance of failing Fletching recipes by 10/?/?%. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Foraging
data.description: This passive ability increases your Forage skill cap by 50 points. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Gather Party
data.description: This ability, when activated, will give everyone in your party the option of teleporting directly to your location. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Innate Eminence
data.description: This passive ability increases your strength, stamina, agility, dexterity, wisdom, intelligence, and charisma by 2/4/6/?/? points. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Innate Lung Capacity
data.description: This passive ability increases the amount of air you can hold in your lungs by 10/?/?%. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Innate Metabolism
data.description: This passive ability reduces your food and drink consumption by 110/125/?%. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Innate Regeneration
data.description: This passive ability increases your health regeneration by 1/2/3/4/5/?/? point(s). Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Innate Spell Resistance
data.description: This passive ability improves your cold, disease, fire, magic, and poison resistances by 2/?/?/?/? points. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Jewel Craft Mastery
data.description: This passive ability reduces the chance of failing Jewelcrafting recipes by 10/?/?%. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Natural Durability
data.description: This passive ability increases your maximum base health (derived from your stamina) by 2/5/10/12%. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Origin
data.description: This ability, when activated, transports you back to your starting city. You can check your origin location using the command /charinfo. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Packrat
data.description: This passive ability reduces the weight of all equipped and carried items by 5/?/?/?/?/?/?/?/?/?%. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Permanent Illusion
data.description: This passive ability extends the duration of your beneficial illusion spells to 16.6 hours and allows them to persist when zoning. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Pottery Mastery
data.description: This passive ability reduces the chance of failing Pottery recipes by 10/?/?%. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Quick Buff
data.description: This ability, when activated, will cast all currently memorized beneficial spells on all valid group and raid targets in range, for full mana and reagent cost. NOTE: This ability will continue casting spells even if you have no mana left.

data.label: Steadfast Will
data.description: This passive ability grants you a 15/30/50/60/70/80/90/100% chance to endure what would otherwise be a stunning melee attack, from any angle, without being stunned. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Stoicism
data.description: This passive ability reduces how far incoming melee attacks push you backward by 10%. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Tailoring Mastery
data.description: This passive ability reduces the chance of failing Tailoring recipes by 10/?/?%. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Acrobatics
data.description: This passive ability reduces the damage that you take from falling by increasing the effectiveness of your safe fall skill by 10/20/30%. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Ambidexterity
data.description: This passive ability increases your chance to successfully dual wield by 32%. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Burst of Power
data.description: This passive ability increases your flurry chance (up to two extra attacks after a primary slot triple attack) by 7%. Requirements: level 46.

data.label: Companion's Discipline
data.description: This passive ability allows you to give your pet advanced commands. Hotkeys for these commands can be created using the pet control window. Hold and Greater Hold - /pet hold -or- /pet ghold. When your pet is in the hold state, your pet will only attack something when you tell it to, and your pet will continue to attack anything on its hate list after that point. Once the encounter is finished, your pet will automatically go back to a held state. If your pet is never told to exclusively attack anything, your pet will never attack anything, even if something is attacking it. The greater hold state forces your pet to not add anything to its hatelist unless specifically added by you. You can add a target to your pet's hatelist with either /pet attack or /pet qattack. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Critical Affliction
data.description: This passive ability increases the chance your damage-over-time spells will deal critical damage at each 6 second interval they are active by 3/6/9%. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Destructive Cascade
data.description: This passive ability increases the damage dealt by your critical damage over time spells by 125/150/175%. Requires Critical Affliction rank 1/2/3. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Destructive Fury
data.description: This passive ability increases the damage dealt by your critical direct damage spells by 30/60/100%. Requirements: level 1, Fury of Magic at level 1.

data.label: Double Riposte
data.description: This passive ability grants you a 5%/10%/15% chance to perform a double riposte. Requirements: level 15.

data.label: Exodus
data.description: This ability, when activated, teleports all group members within a 100 foot radius to a relatively safe location in your current zone with a 0.1 second cast time. Requirements: level 10.

data.label: Finishing Blow
data.description: This passive ability grants your critical melee attacks a 100% chance to deal 100/200/300% damage to level 50/53/55 and lower NPC targets with 10/12/15% or less health. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Fury of Magic
data.description: This passive ability increases your chance to land a critical hit with your direct damage spells by 2%. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Healing Adept
data.description: This passive ability increases the effectiveness of your instant-duration healing spells by 2%. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Healing Boon
data.description: This passive ability increased chance that your heal-over-time spells will exceptionally heal their target by 3/6/9%. An exceptional heal does double healing value of the spell for that 6 second interval. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Healing Gift
data.description: This passive ability grants your instant-duration healing spells a 3%/6%/10% chance to score an exceptional heal. An exceptional heal doubles the healing value of the spell. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Improved Bash
data.description: This passive ability allows you to use your bash skill while wielding a two-handed weapon. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Innate Camouflage
data.description: This ability, when activated, grants you standard invisibility for up to 20 minutes. Requirements: level 40.

data.label: Innate Invis to Undead
data.description: This ability, when activated, renders you invisible to most undead creatures for up to 27 minutes. Requirements: level 40.

data.label: Intimidation
data.description: This passive ability causes successful uses of your intimidate skill to trigger Intimidation I which causes a level 70 or lower target to run away in fear for 0:00:18. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Mass Group Buff
data.description: This ability, when activated, doubles the mana cost of your next spell or ability that can be affected by the Mass Group Buff and causes it to land on all allies within the spell's radius. Requirements: level 50.

data.label: Master of All
data.description: This passive ability allows you to you gain a second specialization. Specialized schools of magic benefit from a from a reduction in mana cost and fizzle chance. After acquiring this ability, the next specialization to go over its current cap becomes your second specialization. Requirements: level 20.

data.label: Mastery of the Past
data.description: This passive ability makes it impossible for you to fizzle level 20/40/52 or lower spells. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Mend Companion
data.description: Mend Companion I, when activated, instantly heals your pet for 5000 health. Requirements: level 39.

data.label: Mental Clarity
data.description: This passive ability increases your mana regeneration by 1 point. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Mnemonic Retention
data.description: This passive ability increases the capacity of your spell casting window allowing you to memorize 1/2/3/4/5/6 additional spell. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Persistent Casting
data.description: This passive ability grants you a 11% chance (per rank) to regain your concentration and complete a spell cast when stunned. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Pet Affinity
data.description: Allows your pet to benefit from group beneficial spells and songs. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Physical Enhancement
data.description: This passive ability increases your melee avoidance by 2% and your armor class soft cap by 2%. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Quick Damage
data.description: This passive ability reduces the base cast time of direct damage spells that have an initial cast time of 3 seconds or more by 2/5/10%. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Rampage
data.description: This ability, when activated, performs a single primary slot combat round on all creatures within a 40 foot radius. Requirements: level 30.

data.label: Spell Casting Deftness
data.description: This passive ability reduces the cast time of beneficial spells that have a duration and an initial cast time of at least 3 seconds by 10%. Requirements: level 1. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Spell Casting Mastery
data.description: This passive ability reduces the mana cost of all spells by 2/5/10%. Req level 1.

data.label: Spell Casting Reinforcement
data.description: This passive ability increases the duration of beneficial spells that you cast by 5/15/30/50%. Spells that grant invulnerability and combat abilities are exempt from this extension. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Spell Casting Subtlety
data.description: This ability is DISABLED. Purchase the 0 cost rank to enable its effects. When enabled, this passive ability reduces the amount of hate generated by your attacks and spells by 5/?/?/?/?/?%. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Thief's Intuition
data.description: This passive ability reduces the reuse time of your Sense Traps and Disarm Traps skills by 1 second. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Banestrike
data.description: This passive ability improves the base damage of your melee attacks and the power of your damaging and healing abilities by 2/4/?/?%. Complete Slayer achievements to progress this ability. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Instrument Mastery
data.description: This passive ability further improves the instrument bonus of your songs by 20/40/60%. This ability impacts Brass, Percussion, String and Woodwind songs. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Jam Fest
data.description: This passive ability increases the effective casting level of your songs by 1/?/? level. This bonus improves: Songs that get stronger or last longer based on your level, song stacking priority on targets, the likelihood that songs that dispel effects will succeed, the likelihood that songs that cure blindness will succeed, the likelihood that songs that sense, disarm, or pick locked traps will succeed. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Reaching Notes
data.description: This ability is ENABLED. Expend the current rank to disable its effects. When enabled, this passive ability extends the radius of your beneficial area songs by 10%. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Scribble Notes
data.description: This passive ability reduces the amount of time that it takes you to memorize a song by 50%. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Singing Mastery
data.description: This passive ability further improves the singing bonus of your songs by 20/40/60%. This ability impacts songs that use the Singing skill. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Symphonic Aura
data.description: This ability is ENABLED. Expend the current rank to disable its effects. When enabled, this passive ability allows one Bard song to auto pulse. In order for a song to be eligible, it must have no mana cost, have no cooldown, and be a non-targeted area of effect song. Any song that meets these criteria cannot be played manually while the ability is turned on. This ability chooses the first eligible song, starting from your final spell gem, and working backwards. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Frenzy of Spirit
data.description: Frenzy of Spirit I, when activated, increases your melee speed by 99% and attack power by 250 points for 0:00:48. Requirements: level 45.

data.label: Hobble of Spirits
data.description: This ability, when activated, grants your pet's melee attacks a chance (with a 150% bonus) to trigger Hobble of Spirits Snare I which reduces its target's movement speed by 40% for 24 seconds. This buff has a permanent duration and a 3 second cast time. Requirements: level 30.

data.label: Paragon of Spirit
data.description: Paragon of Spirit I, when activated, shares your natural attunement with all group members within a 200 foot radius, increasing health regeneration by 200 points and mana regeneration by 80 points for 0:00:36.

data.label: Playing Possum
data.description: This ability, when activated, allows you to instantly Feign Death with an 80% chance of success. Requirements: level 46.

data.label: Blood Rune
data.description: Melee and ability critical hits give you 5% of the damage done as an absorption shield, up to 5% of your max hitpoints. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Tireless Spirit
data.description: This ability, when activated, increases your movement speed by 125% for 18 seconds. Requirements: level 10.

data.label: Unbound Fury
data.description: This passive ability increases your chance to land a critical hit with your melee attacks and abilites by 2%. Requirements: level 12.

data.label: Bestow Divine Aura
data.description: Bestowed Divine Aura I, when activated, instantly renders your target invulnerable to most attacks but also unable to attack and heals 5000 health every 6 seconds for 0:00:18. Requirements: level 50, Divine Aura at level 1.

data.label: Divine Aura
data.description: Divine Aura I, when activated, instantly renders you invulnerable to most attacks but also unable to attack and heals 5000 health every 6 seconds for 0:00:18. Requirements: level 50.

data.label: Purify Soul
data.description: This ability, when activated, cures a target up to 100 feet away of 72 poison, disease, and curse counters and has a 95% chance to remove up to 6 detrimental effects. Requirements: level 15, Healing Gift level 3.

data.label: Turn Undead
data.description: Turn Undead I, when activated, infuses your undead target with holy energy which deals 200 damage every 6 seconds for 0:00:24 and has a 10% chance to trigger Infusion of Holy Light I which critically deals 1000 damage. Requirements: level 40.

data.label: Unbound Boon
data.description: This passive ability grants your healing spells a 2% chance to score an exceptional heal. An exceptional heal doubles the healing value of the spell. Requirements: level 12.

data.label: Enhanced Root
data.description: This passive ability reduces the chance that an NPC target entangled by your root spells will break free when struck by a non-melee attack by 50%. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Quick Evacuation
data.description: This passive ability reduces the cast time of your evacuation and succor spells and abilities by 10%. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Unbound Nature
data.description: This passive ability increases the chance that you will land a critical hit with a spell by 2/3/?%. Requirements: level 12.

data.label: Unbound Clarity
data.description: This passive increases your mana regeneration by 2 points. Requirements: level 12.

data.label: Companion's Fury
data.description: Frenzied Burnout I, when activated, increases your pet's combat prowess for 0:01:06. Frenzied Burnout I increases your pet's armor class by 75 points, overhaste by 15%, strength by 20 points, attack power by 200 points, chance to perform a flurry of attacks on a successful double attack by 5%, and accuracy by 10%. Requirements: level 15.

data.label: Conjurer's Efficiency
data.description: This passive ability prevents components used in the summoning of pets from being expended. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Elemental Form
data.description: Elemental Form I, when activated, transforms you into either an Air, Earth, Fire, or Water Elemental. Increases the maximum that your strength, stamina, agility, dexterity, wisdom, intelligence, and charisma can be raised to by 5 points. Increases the casting level of your spells by 1. Grants a 10 point damage shield. Requirements: level 40.

data.label: Turn Summoned
data.description: Turn Summoned I, when activated, deals 400 damage to your elemental target and has a 5% chance to trigger Infusion of Elemental Light I which critically deals 32000 damage. Requirements: level 45.

data.label: Unbound Companion
data.description: This passive ability increases the chance that your pet will land a critical hit by 2/4/6%. Requirements: level 12.

data.label: Dragon Force
data.description: This ability, when activated, pushes your target backwards and deals 10 damage. Requirements: level 15.

data.label: Improved Mend
data.description: This passive ability gives you a 10% chance to perform a superior mend, doubling the healing of your mend skill. Requirements: level 1, First Aid at level 3.

data.label: Purify Body
data.description: Purification I, when activated, instantly cures you of up to 20 detrimental effects (excluding charm, fear, resurrection, and revival sickness). Requirements: level 15.

data.label: Rapid Feign
data.description: This passive ability reduces the reuse time of your Feign Death skill by 1 second. Requirements: level 17.

data.label: Dead Mesmerization
data.description: Dead Mesmerization I, when activated, mesmerizes up to 12 level 59 or lower undead creatures within a 35 foot radius of your target for 0:00:36. Requirements: level 40.

data.label: Fear Storm
data.description: Fear Storm I, when activated, strikes fear into the hearts of up to 4 level 52 or lower creatures within a 35 foot radius around your target, causing them to run away for 0:00:36. Requirements: level 45.

data.label: Flesh to Bone
data.description: This ability, when activated, converts a meat or body part item you are holding into bone chips. Requirements: level 10.

data.label: Life Burn
data.description: Life Burn I, when activated, consumes 75% of your current health and deals 100% of that health as direct damage then deals 250 damage every 6 seconds for 0:00:36 and blesses you with Lifeburn Recourse I which heals 250 health every 6 seconds for 0:00:36. Requirements: level 45.

data.label: Unbound Affliction
data.description: This passive ability increases the chance your damage-over-time spells will deal critical damage at each 6 second interval they are active by 2/4/6%. Requirements: level 12.

data.label: Act of Valor
data.description: This ability, when activated, allows you to sacrifice yourself in order to transfer all of your remaining health to your target. Requirements: level 20.

data.label: Divine Stun
data.description: Divine Stun I, when activated, instantly pushes your target backwards and attempts to stun a level 70 or lower target for 2 seconds. Requirements: level 35.

data.label: Holy Steed
data.description: This ability, when activated, summons the bridle of a very fast Holy Steed. Requirements: level 20.

data.label: Lay on Hands
data.description: This ability, when activated, instantly heals a friendly target or an unfriendly target's target for 6251 health (scales by level). Requirements: level 6.

data.label: Slay Undead
data.description: This passive ability grants your melee attacks a 2.25% chance to deal 445% damage against undead and vampiric targets. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Valiant Steed
data.description: This ability, when activated, summons the bridle of a very fast Valiant Unicorn. Requirements: level 50, Holy Steed at level 1.

data.label: Hunter's Attack Power
data.description: This passive ability increases your attack power by 20 points. Requirements: level 8.

data.label: Unbounded Strikethrough
data.description: This passive ability increases the chance you will strike through your opponent's active defenses, such as dodge, block, parry, and riposte, by 10/20/30%. Requirements: level 12.

data.label: Weapon Mastery of the Scout
data.description: Increases the base damage of your archery attacks by 30/60/90%. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Chaotic Stab
data.description: This passive ability allows your backstab attacks to deal minimal backstab damage if you are not behind your target. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Escape
data.description: This ability, when activated, allows you to escape combat from NPCs that are 20 or fewer levels higher than you, causes you to be the last possible target of rampage attacks from any current attacker, and triggers Evader's Invisibility which grants permanent invisibility. This ability consumes 2% of your endurance to activate. Requirements: level 10.

data.label: Purge Poison
data.description: This ability, when activated, cures you of 1200 poison counters. Requirements: level 15.

data.label: Shroud of Stealth
data.description: This passive ability provides you a previously unheard of level of stealth that increases the invisibility offered by your Hide skill to tier 2, shadowing you from creatures that normally see through standard invisibility. Requirements: level 35.

data.label: Abyssal Steed
data.description: This ability, when activated, summons the bridle of a very fast Abyssal Nightmare. Requirements: level 50, Unholy Steed at level 1.

data.label: Harm Touch
data.description: Harm Touch II, when activated, grips a non-player target with agony, instantly dealing up to 751 damage based on your current level. Requirements: level 6.

data.label: Leech Touch
data.description: Leech Touch I, when activated, instantly drains 900 health from your target. Requirements: level 40.

data.label: Soul Abrasion
data.description: This passive ability increases the base damage of lifetaps triggered by Vampiric Embrace and Scream of Death by 50/100/200%. Requirements: level 15.

data.label: Unholy Steed
data.description: This ability, when activated, summons the bridle of a very fast Unholy Steed. Requirements: level 20.

data.label: Cannibalization
data.description: Cannibalization I, when activated, consumes 1540 health to restore 1066 mana. Requirements: level 40, Mental Clarity at level 3.

data.label: Unbound Cascade
data.description: This passive ability increases the damage dealt by your critical damage-over-time spells by 10/20/30%. Requirements: level 12.

data.label: Area Taunt
data.description: Area Taunt I, when activated, taunts all creatures within a 40 foot radius, placing you 100 points of hate higher than your opponents' previously most hated target. Requirements: level 25.

data.label: Heroic Leap
data.description: Heroic Leap I, when activated, causes you to leap approximately 10 feet in front of your target, attracting the attention of up to 8 opponents within a 40 foot radius of your target, increasing their hatred for you by 1250 points. Requirements: level 12.

data.label: Unbound Wrath
data.description: This passive ability increases your melee critical hit damage by 10/20/30%. Requirements: level 12.

data.label: War Cry
data.description: War Cry I, when activated, grants all group members within a 100 foot radius immunity to fear spells for 10 seconds. Requirements: level 25, Fear Resistance at level 3.

data.label: Warrior's Endurance
data.description: This passive ability increases your hit point regeneration by 1% per 6 seconds. Requirements: level 30.

data.label: Improved Familiar
data.description: Improved Familiar I, which when activated, triggers Summon Improved Familiar I, the physical manifestation of your familiar, increases the damage dealt by your critical direct damage spells by 3%, the casting levels of your spells by 9, your cold, disease, fire, magic, and poison resistances by 25 points, your mana regeneration by 6 points, your maximum mana by 200 points, and allows you to see invisible creatures. Requirements: level 45.

data.label: Mana Burn
data.description: Mana Burn I, when activated, consumes up to 3000 mana to deal 4x of the consumed mana as direct damage and prevents additional Mana Burn spells from landing on that target for 0:01:00. Requirements: level 45, Mental Clarity at level 3.

data.label: Quick Evacuation
data.description: This passive ability reduces the cast time of your evacuation and succor spells and abilities by 10/?/?%. Requirements: level 1.

data.label: Strong Root
data.description: This ability, when activated, roots your target in place for up to 48 seconds with a 300 point resist modifier and a 2 second cast time. Requirements: level 35.

data.label: Unbound Destruction
data.description: This passive ability increases your chance to land a critical hit with your direct damage spells by 2/4/6%. Requirements: level 12.

data.label: Blood Siphon Strike
data.description: Drains the life from your target, doing 56 damage every six seconds for 00:00:36, and healing your wounds for the same amount, effect Duration: 6 seconds.

data.label: Asp Venom Strike
data.description: Deals 62 points of poison damage to your target.

data.label: Weakening Strike
data.description: Weakens your targets limbs, slowing their attack rate for 0:03:30, effect duration 24 seconds.

data.label: Hobbling Strike
data.description: Snare. Cut's circulation to your target's legs, slowing their movement speed for up to 0:03:00, effect duration 48 seconds.

data.label: Concussive Strike
data.description: Causes your opponent to twitch violently, interrupting spell casting 75% of the time, pushback 2.

data.label: Befuddling Strike
data.description: Causes your opponent to clutch their head, draining their mana by 110.

data.label: Grounding Strike
data.description: Blocks the nerves to your opponent's legs, rooting them for up to 0:01:00.

data.label: Stunning Strike
data.description: Injects a paralytic agent, stunning your opponent. This effect works on creatures up to level 50. Pushback 1.

data.label: Banishing Poison
data.description: Dispel. Only one utility poison can be active at a time.

data.label: Lay Hands
data.description: An instant heal equal to roughly 32x the paladin's level to a single target (1,728 HP at level 60).

data.label: Harm Touch
data.description: Deals a large amount of damage to a single target, scaling from 11 at level 1 to 1,001 at level 60.

data.label: Backstab
data.description: Massive damage with a piercing weapon in the main hand, if the target's back (or side, within 180°) is exposed; otherwise lands as a normal hit. Damage scales with skill and the equipped dagger.

data.label: Mend
data.description: Heals the user for 25% of their total health. Below 100 skill, a failed attempt can damage instead of heal.

data.label: Bash
data.description: Uses an equipped shield to bash the current target for a chance to stun; the shield's AC affects damage. Shares a cooldown with Slam.

data.label: Kick
data.description: A leg strike dealing direct damage. Shares a cooldown with Bash, Slam, and the Monk kick-family specials (Round Kick, Tiger Claw, Eagle Strike, Dragon Punch/Tail Rake).

data.label: Taunt
data.description: A small chance to move the user to the top of the target's aggro list. Has no effect on a target already attacking the user.

data.label: Hide
data.description: Grants an Invisibility-like effect as long as the user doesn't move; higher skill increases success chance. (Also granted to Dark Elves/Wood Elves/Halflings by race, capped at 50 — not shown here since the Class Browser is organized by class.)

data.label: Sneak
data.description: Moves silently and appears Indifferent to any NPC not facing the user. (Also granted to Halflings by race, capped at 50 — not shown here since the Class Browser is organized by class.)

data.label: Disarm
data.description: Dislodges the target's wielded weapon, forcing it to fight hand-to-hand. Against NPCs the weapon becomes lootable rather than dropping to the ground.

data.label: Pick Lock
data.description: Unlocks doors that normally require a key, for as long as the door stays open. Always succeeds if skill meets the door's minimum, always fails (no skill-up chance) if it doesn't.

data.label: Pick Pocket
data.description: Attempts to steal an item or coin from a humanoid enemy. Cannot be used while auto-attacking, and can't target magic or wielded items.

data.label: Disarm Traps
data.description: Disables environmental traps so a group can pass safely.

data.label: Round Kick
data.description: A Monk special attack, superseded by Tiger Claw at level 10.

data.label: Tiger Claw
data.description: A Monk special attack replacing Round Kick, superseded by Eagle Strike at level 20.

data.label: Eagle Strike
data.description: A Monk special attack replacing Tiger Claw, superseded by Dragon Punch/Tail Rake at level 25. Max damage at level 20 is 16.

data.label: Dragon Punch
data.description: A Monk special attack replacing Eagle Strike, for Human Monks (Iksar Monks get Tail Rake instead). Superseded by Flying Kick at level 30.

data.label: Tail Rake
data.description: A Monk special attack replacing Eagle Strike, for Iksar Monks (Human Monks get Dragon Punch instead). Superseded by Flying Kick at level 30.

data.label: Katta's Song of Sword Dancing line
Stonebrunt Mountains
data.lore: The Stonebrunt Mountains is a very spiritual place. It is the home of the Kejekan people, who rule over the land atop Mount Klaw, within the small fortress of Kejek.

data.label: Forage
data.description: Finds food and other useful items from the local environment on a timer. Druid's cap scales with level ((Level×5)+5); also granted to Iksar/Wood Elf by race, fixed at 50 — not shown here since the Class Browser is organized by class.

data.label: Tracking
data.description: Follows traces of other creatures over distance; higher skill and certain classes track farther (Ranger tracks best, then Druid, then Bard).

data.label: Safe Fall
data.description: Reduces or prevents damage from long falls.

data.label: Sense Traps
data.description: Detects traps on objects or in passageways before they trigger.

data.label: Breastplate of Ro
data.source: Armor of Ro questline reward, combined at a forge from a Mold of Ro + Bar of Ronium

data.label: Mold of Ro Bracer
data.description: David's share of the Armor of Ro questline, trading proof of Deepwater Knights standing for a mold that becomes the Bracer of Ro.
steps: Reach Amiable faction with the Deepwater Knights
Obtain 2x Deepwater Goblin Nets (from a goblin net master, Lake Rathetear)
Turn it in to David in Rathe Mountains for a Mold of Ro Bracer
Combine the mold with a Bar of Ronium at a non-cultural forge for the finished Bracer of Ro

data.label: Mold of Ro Bracer
data.source: Reward for turning in 2x Deepwater Goblin Nets to David (Rathe Mountains, Deepwater Knights faction)

data.label: Journeyman's Boots
data.description: Hasten Bootstrutter, a gnome who never stops wandering Rathe Mountains, trades a permanent movement-speed clicky for a Ring of the Ancients, a borrowed Shadowed Rapier, and a small fortune in gold.
steps: Obtain a Ring of the Ancients
Kill an Ancient Cyclops (found in Ocean of Tears, Southern Desert of Ro, South Karana, or East Karana) for a Shadowed Rapier -- it vanishes 30 minutes after logging off, so don't dawdle turning it in
Gather 3,250 gold pieces (actual gold coin, not platinum)
Track down Hasten Bootstrutter in Rathe Mountains and turn in all three before he wanders off

data.label: Journeyman's Boots
data.effect: JourneymanBoots (movement speed, Instant cast, outdoor use only)
data.source: Journeyman's Boots quest reward (Hasten Bootstrutter, Rathe Mountains)

data.label: Research Aid
data.description: Mrysila, Northern Karana's resident scholar, trades lightstones for spell-research aids -- a repeatable turn-in, not a one-time quest.
steps: Reach at least Apprehensive faction with Mrysila (Dubious or worse consumes your items without reward)
Turn in a Lightstone (a common willowisp drop) for a Runes and Research tome
Turn in a Greater Lightstone for a Concordance of Research

data.label: Concordance of Research
data.source: Tradeskill container for spell research; reward for turning in a Greater Lightstone to Mrysila (Research Aid quest)

data.label: Paladin Epic Quest
data.description: The long road to a Fiery Defender: purify three tainted darksteel pieces across three separate zone-spanning sub-quests, then combine them with a Fiery Avenger for Irak Altil in the Plane of Fear.
steps: Obtain the Tainted Darksteel Breastplate from Thought Destroyer in the Plane of Hate, then purify it via Jark and Nella Stonebraids in Kaladim for a Pure Crystal
Obtain the Tainted Darksteel Sword from the Keeper of the Tombs in The Hole, then purify it by helping a peasant woman and her brother Joshua in West Freeport for a Bucket of Pure Water
Obtain the Tainted Darksteel Shield from Kirak Vil in Nektulos Forest, then purify it through Elia the Pure in Felwithe
Return all three purified pieces to Reklon Gnallen in Erudin's Temple of Quellious for the Mark of Atonement
Complete the separate Fiery Avenger prerequisite quest
Turn in the Mark of Atonement and the Fiery Avenger to Irak Altil in the Plane of Fear

data.label: Fiery Defender
data.source: Paladin Epic Quest final reward (Irak Altil, Plane of Fear)

data.label: Cleric Epic Quest
data.description: A three-orb odyssey across Norrath's oceans and volcanoes, ending with the Water Sprinkler of Nem Ankh from the Avatar of Water.
steps: Orb of Frozen Water: kill Lord Bergurgle and trade his crown to Shmendrik Lavawalker, defeat the Spirit of Flame, trade its Damaged Goblin Crown to Natasha Whitewater for an Ornate Sea Shell, give the shell to Omat Vastsea in Timorous Deep for a Coral Statue, present the statue to A Seeker in the Temple of Solusek Ro (it becomes A Plasmatic Priest -- defeat it), kill Lord Gimblox in Solusek's Eye, then return the Plasmatic Priest Robe to Omat

Orb of Clear Water: trade Lord Gimblox's Signet Ring to Natasha for a second Ornate Sea Shell, give it to Naxot Deepwater in Burning Woods to spawn Ixiblat Fer, kill it for a Sceptre, kill Overking Bathezid in Chardok for a Singed Scroll, then trade both to Omat

Orb of Vapor: give a Message to Natasha for a Shimmering Pearl, present it to Zordak Ragefire in Nagafen's Lair (it becomes Zordakalicus Ragefire), kill it and loot its Heart, then trade the heart to Omat
Give all three orbs to Jhassad Oceanson for the Orb of Triumvirate
Present the Orb of Triumvirate to the Avatar of Water

data.label: Water Sprinkler of Nem Ankh
data.source: Cleric Epic Quest final reward (the Avatar of Water)

data.label: Armor of Ro
data.description: A Paladin-only armor set. Each piece has its own independent faction-gated turn-in at the Rathe Mountains paladin camp for a Mold of Ro; combine any mold with a hand-crafted Bar of Ronium at a non-cultural forge for the finished piece. There's no need to do all seven.
steps: Reach Amiable faction with Lord Searfire in the Temple of Solusek Ro

Gather the five Bar of Ronium ingredients: 2x Enchanted Platinum Bar, Melatite (from clockworks in Solusek's Eye), Mistmoore Granite (from gargoyles in Mistmoore Castle), Sand of Ro (from sand giants in the Ro zones), and Soil of Underfoot (from Priestess Ghalea in Kaladim)
Combine the ingredients into a Bar of Ronium at a Sol Cauldron
Complete any of the seven Mold of Ro sub-quests at the Rathe Mountains paladin camp
Combine the mold and the Bar of Ronium at a non-cultural forge for the matching finished piece

data.label: Mold of Ro Boots
data.description: Nicholas's share of the Armor of Ro questline, trading proof of Clerics of Underfoot standing for a mold that becomes the Boots of Ro.
steps: Reach Amiable faction with the Clerics of Underfoot
Obtain Kilij Plans (from Sandgiant Husam, South Ro)
Turn it in to Nicholas in Rathe Mountains for a Mold of Ro Boots
Combine the mold with a Bar of Ronium at a non-cultural forge for the finished Boots of Ro

data.source: Reward for turning in Kilij Plans to Nicholas (Rathe Mountains, Clerics of Underfoot faction)
